title: Find concrete evidence that a niche already has budgets
purpose: Verify that paid intent research distinguishes hard payment signals from weak proxy signals.
prompt: Audit whether 'AI appointment follow-up for local service businesses' has paid intent. Do not assume demand from AI hype. List hard and weak signals separately, then decide whether to continue research.
expected_behaviors: Looks for hard signals such as paid SaaS, agency offers, ads, pricing pages, consultants, marketplaces, jobs, RFPs, or active spending.
Labels weak signals such as blog posts, social chatter, free templates, and generic search volume.
Connects payment evidence to a specific buyer and budget owner.
States confidence and what evidence would change the decision.
Does not recommend build without at least two hard paid-intent signals.
failure_patterns: Uses anecdotal interest as payment proof.
Does not separate buyer from end user.
Gives a positive decision without pricing or spending evidence.
judge_notes: Passing output must include both hard and weak signal buckets.
